content: Concrete separation pattern: TradeMathCore.mqh holds only pure functions (pip/point conversion, lot normalization, stop validation, exposure math) with fixed inputs/outputs; TestLite.mqh provides AssertTrue/AssertEqualsInt/AssertNearDouble helpers that collect all failures instead of stopping at first; UnitTestRunner.mq5 is a Script entry point that calls the pure functions with fixed test cases and prints a pass/fail report. This runs standalone (right-click Run in MetaEditor / drag onto any chart) with zero dependency on Strategy Tester or historical data.
